description:
KineGate helps developers decide whether an issuer-specific tokenized-stock purchase is ready to proceed. It shows thirteen deterministic evidence checks, the reason for each WAIT or BLOCK, and an expiring SHA-256-bound audit receipt. Changing the intent, policy or source invalidates that receipt. Hashes establish internal consistency; they do not authenticate an issuer.

Judges can test sixteen clearly labelled FIXTURE scenarios without a wallet, then inspect a separate REPLAY of recorded Binance Web3 evidence. The project uses RWA Data, Trading and Transaction APIs for Ondo AAPLon on BSC: authenticated asset discovery, price, issuer profile and underlying-market calls succeeded; a real LiquidMesh quote and unsigned SWAP response were captured for a 6-USDT input.

Six controlled BSC eth_simulateV1 samples compare identical payloads at pinned parent blocks. The 450,000 swap-gas limit failed; a bounded higher limit succeeded; doubling the matching minimum-output word failed. Exact integer checks exposed floor-rounding at the requested 0.5% bound. A later 0.49% builder request met the unchanged authorized 0.5% minimum, while preserving the stricter request's rounding failure.

These are counterfactual simulations with virtual approvals. No actual approval, wallet signature, broadcast or purchase occurred. Full Binance router/facet provenance and ABI verification remain incomplete; the official SDK documentation question is https://github.com/binance/binance-web3-connector-js/issues/7. Current evidence and personal signing must still pass before a real demonstration. The public product cannot sign or broadcast. Public source, deployment, a 134-second narrated demo and a standalone local package are available.
deployedOrRunnableInstructions: https://zoahdev.github.io/kinegate/ ; local: npm ci, npm start, open http://127.0.0.1:4173. No credentials or wallet needed for FIXTURE and recorded REPLAY. Standalone local package is available in v0.3.0 release.

Issuer/venue qualifications for the bounded purchase were separately confirmed privately. Technical validation and personal signing remain required.
